_meta.offpeak_source: OSRM demo server (router.project-osrm.org, OpenStreetMap data; free-flow, no traffic)
_meta.rush_method: off-peak x 1.683 (TomTom Traffic Index 2025, New York: morning rush-hour congestion 68.3%, https://www.tomtom.com/traffic-index/city/new-york-ny/) plus 5-45 min for the inbound Hudson crossing queue (typical weekday 7-9 AM inbound Lincoln Tunnel wait 20-45 min per TollGuru, https://tollguru.com/lincoln-tunnel-toll; tunnel crossing itself about 4-8 min per MTA figures reported by nj.com, Jan 2025). Typical, not live.

safety.source: NJ State Police Uniform Crime Report 2023 and 2024 (Index Crimes by County), violent crimes per 1,000 residents
safety.tax_source: NJ Treasury 2025 average residential tax bill / average sale price (BellaZu v2 town screen)
